response.justification: While this candidate demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and valuable DevOps expertise, they critically lack the mandatory technical requirements. C++ experience is minimal (approximately 6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015) and not recent; the role requires 5-10 years of current hands-on expertise. Additionally, there is no demonstrated Windows platform experience, SQL Server/Oracle proficiency, or Capital Markets/Fixed Income domain knowledge. The candidate's career trajectory has progressed toward web/full-stack development, moving away from the systems programming required for capital markets applications.
strengths: Strong software engineering fundamentals with deep commitment to TDD, CI/CD practices, and software craftsmanship principles
Hands-on DevOps and CI/CD infrastructure expertise demonstrated through GitLab administration, CI server setup, and containerization experience
Excellent communication and mentoring abilities evidenced by conference talks, published workshops, and active open-source contributions
concerns: Critically insufficient C++ experience: only ~6 months in 2014-2015; role mandatorily requires 5-10 years of strong hands-on C++ expertise
No demonstrated Windows platform experience; entire career focused on Linux, web technologies, and cloud environments rather than systems programming
Absence of Capital Markets, Fixed Income, Investment Banking domain expertise and no SQL Server/Oracle experience; background is primarily web and fintech rather than capital markets systems
